input.quote: Any controversy or claim arising out of or relating to this Agreement, or the breach thereof, shall be settled by arbitration administered by the American Arbitration Association under its Commercial Arbitration Rules
input.rationale: Delaware law with exclusive jurisdiction in the New York state and federal courts (Section 14(a)) sits within our accepted list, but Section 8 mandates AAA arbitration and directly conflicts with that exclusive court venue. Our position is courts rather than arbitration, so we delete the arbitration mandate and route disputes to the New York courts already agreed in Section 14(a).

input.quote: either Party may assign this Agreement without approval or consent to any affiliate or purchaser of all or substantially all of said Party's assets related to the subject matter of this Agreement or to any successor by way of merger, stock sale, consolidation or similar transaction
input.rationale: Customer may assign without consent to an affiliate or to a successor by merger, stock sale or asset sale, other assignments require consent that may not be unreasonably withheld, and there is no Vendor termination or re-pricing right triggered by Customer's change of control. This meets our fallback (mutual successor assignment) and no redline is warranted.

input.quote: Each Party's names, trademarks and logos are the exclusive property of said respective Party, and neither Party will acquire any proprietary rights therein by reason of this Agreement or any other agreement.
input.rationale: The only ownership provision covers names, trademarks and logos: the Agreement never states who owns Customer Data, Requests, Content or deliverables, even though Kubient collects, stores and manages visitor data and provides "deliverables" under Section 9(b). No IP is assigned to Kubient, but the silence leaves our data and paid-for deliverables unprotected, so we add an ownership sentence for Customer Data and deliverables, a licence-back for embedded Kubient IP, and a no-joint-ownership statement.

input.quote: Kubient hereby grants to Customer a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-assignable, without right of sublicense, revocable license to access, participate in and use to the full extent the Auction Platform as hosted by Kubient,
input.rationale: The grant is expressly revocable, non-transferable and non-assignable, and it names only Customer — our affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf are excluded (and Section 6(a) bars third-party access absent Kubient's consent). We extend the grant to affiliates and contractors, make it transferable to a successor, and limit revocation to termination or our uncured material breach.
